query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.cardNumber, ph.price, ph.grade, ph.soldAt
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN priceHistory ph ON c.id = ph.cardId
WHERE (c.name LIKE '%Lillie%Full Force%' OR c.nameJa LIKE '%リーリエの全力%')
  AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY c.id, ph.soldAt DESC
LIMIT 100;
